retirement_age.notes: Statutory age is 65 for men. For women it is being raised in half-year steps by birth cohort from 60 to 65 between 2024 and 2033 (women born after 30 June 1968 retire at 65). The women's value of 61.5 is the 2026 figure given in a secondary reference and applies to one birth cohort; it differs by year of birth. statutory is set to the highest value (men, 65).
